en-US.description: A desktop utility for launching DeepSeek Harness (DSH) locally and securely connecting to remote DSH instances through the system OpenSSH client.
en-US.longDescription: DSH Tunnel can launch a local DSH instance, create local SSH tunnels to remote DSH instances, and open the corresponding WebUI in your default browser. Save and manage multiple remote DSH hosts, securely access remote WebUIs through SSH local port forwarding, connect to multiple DSH instances at the same time using independent local ports, open the default browser automatically when a connection is ready, and access common actions from the Windows system tray. On first connection you can verify the SSH host fingerprint of the target device in the interface, and the app generates a dedicated SSH key pair automatically.

zh-CN.description: 用于启动本机 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），并通过系统 OpenSSH 安全连接远程 DSH 的桌面工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: DSH Tunnel 可以启动本机 DSH，也可以为远程 DSH 建立本地 SSH 隧道，并在默认浏览器中打开对应的 WebUI。支持保存和管理多个远程 DSH 主机，通过 SSH 本地端口转发安全访问远程 WebUI，可同时连接多个 DSH 并为每个连接分配独立的本地端口；连接可用后自动打开默认浏览器，并可通过 Windows 系统托盘快速操作。首次连接可在界面中核对目标设备的 SSH 主机指纹，并自动生成应用专用 SSH 密钥。
zh-CN.name: DSH Tunnel
